summary.note: Each row is one cross-package relative target the importing nested package (ui-react, ui-styling, ui locale, tests) reaches through a path. The rule fires once for the framework package and once for its -rs twin per edge. Alternatives per row: export the target from @semio-tech/framework (proposedSubpath), or relocate the importer's dependency into the importing package.
